name: Simplanova
title: Simplanova Serbia

points: AL development and integrations for Business Central customers
Hands-on exposure to Croatian fiscalization and e-invoicing (Fina)

AI coding agents and Docker-based environments in daily AL work

project.title: Featured project: automated daily payouts
project.text: A payment platform sends its daily merchant settlements straight into Business Central, and BC turns them into payout and revenue journals, with no spreadsheets in between.
points: Custom Business Central API that the platform calls with REST POST requests, authenticated server-to-server through Microsoft Entra ID (OAuth 2.0)
Validation on intake with clear error findings per settlement
Mapping matrices in BC decide accounts, dimensions and currencies (EUR, SEK, PLN), so rule changes never touch the other system
Journal engine that builds payout and revenue journals, run on demand or by job queue
Least-privilege permission set for the integration, with certificate-based authentication for production
62 test scenarios automated with PowerShell against the live API, plus a Postman collection

fun: After years at companies abroad, working in my native language felt strange at first.
It took a while to get used to Business Central terms in the Balkan languages.
